shared_elements: schematic incised or carved linear motifs
justification: Both surfaces carry carved anthropomorphic imagery, but that is as far as the correspondence goes: A shows a flat, stick-limbed figure brandishing a hafted implement, a horned animal and a manned boat with a row of crew strokes, while B is a monumental three-dimensional human-form statue whose back bears curvilinear relief motifs, concentric discs and a small crowning figure. There is no shared specific motif, no comparable relationship between elements (no boat, no weapon, no animals in B; no discs or relief-band scheme in A), and the depictive conventions — silhouette stick-figure narrative scene versus low-relief symbolic panels on a body — are quite different.
